en.title: GitHub: LB623/no-negative-echo
en.hook: Let Codex generate titles, comments, and PRs from final outcomes to eliminate failed trial residues.
key_takeaways: Automatically generates comments, commits, and PRs based solely on the final successful result
Minimizes the residue of rejected solutions or discarded ideas during the coding process
Enhances code review quality and maintains a clean, professional Git history
